anvil:aws:OrgAccount.description: A member account created by an Anvil Org. Used by anvil.Org; deleting it never closes the account: it's moved to Suspended, tagged anvil:lifecycle=suspended and released.

name.description: The account name. Changing it renames the account (account:PutAccountName).

email.description: Root email, used only at creation. AWS needs the root user to change it, so a later change here is ignored with a warning.

ouId.description: The OU the account lives in.

suspendedOuId.description: The Suspended OU the account moves to when removed from config.

orgName.description: The Org project name, tagged on the account as anvil:org.

deployerArns.description: Exact IAM ARNs anvil-org-automation trusts (Org's deployers).

ouId.description: The OU the account is in.

rootEmail.description: The root email the account was created with.

automationRoleArn.description: ARN of anvil-org-automation in the account.
